snippet.title: Magic Roguelike - Folly of the Wizards - Coming 19th September
snippet.description:
Find out more: https://numskullgames.com/game/folly-of-the-wizards/

Folly Of The Wizards is a comedic 2D roguelike action game that puts you in the shoes of a clumsy wizard apprentice. Join a wacky wizard cult and use unique spells to defeat enemies, explore procedurally generated dungeons, and save the world from chaos.

But beware: the fate of the world rests on your shoulders, and even the smallest decision can have a huge impact. With charming hand-drawn art, quirky characters, and unpredictable gameplay, Folly of the Wizards is the perfect adventure for anyone who loves humour, magic, and mayhem.
